title: French greetings & introductions
examples: How do I say hello in French?
What is the difference between tu and vous?
Can you help me introduce myself in French?

explain.say: Today we learn some simple French greetings and introductions. We will learn how to say hello in different ways.
Next we learn how to say your name in French. You can say je m'appelle for this. It means I call myself.
French has two ways to say you. We use tu for friends and people we know well. We use vous for people we do not know.
Let us practice saying hello to a new classmate. You can say bonjour and then je m'appelle.
Imagine you meet a new teacher at school. You should use vous when you speak to them. You can say bonjour madame.
A common mistake is using tu when speaking to an adult. Remember to use vous to be polite always.

faq.q: What is the difference between bonjour and salut?
faq.a: Bonjour is a more formal way to say hello. Salut is more casual and you use it with friends.

faq.q: When do I use tu instead of vous?
faq.a: You use tu when you are speaking to a friend or a child. You use vous for people you do not know well.
asks: Who do I use vous with?
Can I use tu with my teacher?

faq.q: How do I introduce myself if I am nervous?
faq.a: You can start by saying bonjour and then follow with je m'appelle. Speak slowly and remember to smile.
asks: Is it okay to forget my name?

faq.q: Does 'je m'appelle' change for different people?
faq.a: No, the phrase je m'appelle stays the same. You just replace the brackets with your actual name.
asks: Do I say 'je m'appelle' every time?
What if my name is long?

faq.q: Is it okay to use English if I forget the French?
faq.a: It is okay to pause and ask for help. Try to remember that bonjour means hello.
asks: Can I just point at someone?

facts: Bonjour means 'good day' and is used widely.
Salut is the informal equivalent of 'hi'.
Je m'appelle means 'my name is' in French.
Tu is used for familiar people, while vous is for others.

quiz.say: You meet the principal of your school. What should you say?
quiz.why: Because the principal is a stranger, you must use the polite greeting and introduction.

wrong.1: Salut is too informal for a principal.
wrong.2: You must always start with a greeting like bonjour.
wrong.3: You cannot replace your name with the word vous.

quiz.say: If you are talking to your best friend, which greeting is best?
quiz.why: Salut is the casual greeting perfect for friends.

wrong.1: Bonjour is a little too formal for a best friend.
wrong.2: This is a question, not just a greeting.
wrong.3: This is for introducing your name, not just saying hi.

quiz.say: You are speaking to a group of new classmates. Which pronoun should you use when addressing them?
quiz.why: When speaking to a group, you always use the plural form, vous.

wrong.1: Tu is only for one friend.
wrong.2: Bonjour is a greeting, not a pronoun.
wrong.3: Salut is also a greeting, not a pronoun.
